name: What factors determine the cost of garage trim installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of garage trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install garage trim depends on the perimeter size of your garage door openings, the material selected, and whether hidden frame repairs are required. Simple jobs using standard primed wood trim on a single-car garage run lower, whereas multi-car garages using high-durability composite PVC or custom profiles cost more. Additionally, if moisture has damaged the rough framing or jambs beneath the existing boards, repairing that structural framing will expand the scope. A personalized estimate after evaluating the garage structure provides the most accurate pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the total linear footage, chosen material (wood vs. PVC), profile complexity, and whether hidden framing repairs or drywall patching are needed underneath.
